questions.q: What is a governance architecture review board's role, according to this lesson?
options: The standing group that reviews and decides on significant architecture changes on an ongoing basis
A one-time committee that approves the architecture and then disbands
A help desk for resetting employee passwords
The team responsible for writing all SQL queries
questions.explain: The board keeps making and revisiting decisions as the architecture evolves — it's ongoing, not a one-time kickoff committee.

questions.q: Why does the lesson warn against giving a review board too many permanent seats?
options: A board trying to represent every stakeholder becomes too large to actually decide anything
Company policy limits all meetings to three attendees
More seats automatically means slower software releases
Permanent seats are not allowed under most data privacy laws
questions.explain: The lesson states a board with too many permanent seats 'performs' rather than deliberates — size kills decisiveness.

questions.q: Which of these should NOT reach the review board's agenda, per this lesson?
options: Routine data-quality fixes and individual access requests
A significant, hard-to-reverse ADR
A proposed change to the governance operating model
A policy exception outside the standard policy
questions.explain: Routine fixes and individual access requests belong to existing steward roles — sending them to the board creates a bottleneck.

questions.q: What three things does the lesson say a board's charter must define at minimum?
options: Quorum, decision rights, and an escalation path
Logo, slogan, and meeting room number
Budget, vendor list, and office location
Dress code, parking policy, and holiday schedule
questions.explain: Quorum, decision rights, and escalation path are the minimum elements the lesson says must be written down in advance.

questions.q: What does Chapter 6, covered next, do with the concepts from this course?
options: Applies them to full fictional case studies, starting with a global manufacturer
Replaces them with an entirely new framework
Focuses solely on SQL query optimization
Covers how to install a specific vendor's software
questions.explain: Chapter 6, Applied Architecture, works through two labeled-fictional case studies before a hands-on practice lab and closing lesson.
